name: American Museum of Natural History
address: 200 Central Park West, New York, NY 10024
tagline: The dinosaur halls, the blue whale, the Hayden Planetarium — all under one roof.
description: One of the largest natural history museums in the world. The fourth-floor dinosaur halls are the headline attraction; the Hayden Planetarium and the 94-foot fiberglass blue whale in the Hall of Ocean Life are close behind.
review_long:
The fourth floor is what most visitors come for: the world's largest collection of mounted dinosaur skeletons arranged by evolutionary cladistics rather than period, so you walk through the actual branches of the dinosaur family tree. The Hall of Ocean Life with its life-size blue whale model overhead is the second draw, and the Hayden Planetarium next door rounds out a half-day visit.

The new Richard Gilder Center, opened in 2023, added 230,000 square feet including the Insectarium and Butterfly Vivarium. Worth folding into the trip.

tips.text: The Gilder Center entrance on Columbus Ave has shorter lines.

highlights.item: T. rex, Apatosaurus, and the dinosaur cladogram
